JAI KAPOOR   
 
 STATE NCT OF DELHI & ORS. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 CORAM:

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS MAHAJAN  
% 14.03.2024 CRL.M.A. 8115/2024 & CRL.M.A. 8116/2024 (Exemptions)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
W.P.(CRL) 861/2024 2.

The present petition has been filed against the impugned order dated 02.01.2023 passed by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate-06, Patiala House Court, whereby cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 420/188/120B/34 IPC and Section 51 of Disaster Management Act, 2005 and Section 3 of Epidemic Act, 1897 and resultantly, the petitioner has been summoned to stand the trial.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the offences under This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/03/2024 at 22:15:39 Sections 188 and 120B IPC, as well as, under Section 51 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005 have also been invoked in the present case, therefore, in view of the specific bar contained under Section 195 Cr.P.C., as well as Section 60 of the Disaster Management Act, the learned Trial Court could not have taken cognizance of the said offences.

4. Elaborating on her submissions, the learned counsel submits that under Section 195 (1)(a) CrPC,
no Court can take cognizance except on the complaint in writing of the public servant concerned.

Similar is the position under Section 60 of the Disaster Management Act and Section 3 of the Jai Kapoor vs State Nct Of Delhi & Ors on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61924541/

sentences.text: 5. According to the learned counsel, in the present case there is no complaint in writing made by any public servant.
6. In view of the above, issue notice.
Learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State accepts notice.

7. Let the Status Report be filed before the next date.
8.
Re - notify on 22.05.2024.
9. This is an application seeking stay of the proceedings of the criminal case.

10. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that since the petitioner has prima facie case in his favour, the proceedings of the criminal case pending before the Court of learned Metropolitan Magistrate-06, Patiala House Court, New Delhi may be stayed.

sentences.text: 11. Considering the fact that the impugned order is of 02.01.2023 and the present petition has been filed belatedly, the trial proceedings are not being stayed for the present, but keeping in view that notice in the petition has This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/03/2024 at 22:15:39 been issued finding some merit in the submissions of the learned counsel, the petitioner is granted liberty to move an application before the learned Trial Court to seek an adjournment for the next date of hearing.

12. Re-notify on 22.05.2024.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J MARCH 14, 2024/MR
